init_ImageNet22k_dataset: create an ImageNet22k dataset instance with root and extra paths for memory-mapped tarball access
get_image_data_by_index: retrieve raw image bytes for a given sample index from the ImageNet22k dataset
get_targets_array: get all class labels as a numpy array from the ImageNet22k dataset

dump_extra_cache: pre-compute and save entries and class IDs as numpy arrays to the extra directory
